The wordmark

The app icon with the name, in the display face. The page’s own script in the header; both scripts in the footer and on the social card.

In the header

Icon 32 px, the name at 23 px, 11 px apart. The page’s script only: Maktaba on English pages, مكتبة on Arabic ones.

Maktaba32
مكتبة32

Both scripts: footer and social card

The page’s script first, then a brass rule, then the other script. On an Arabic page the order runs right to left.

Maktabaمكتبة
مكتبةMaktaba

Sizes

From the largest use down to the smallest allowed.

Maktaba72Maktaba48Maktaba32Maktaba24

Smallest

Under 24 px the name is left out, and the icon stands alone: the favicon and the touch icons.

2416favicon-32.png @16

Clear space

Half the icon’s width on every side, kept free of text and edges.

Maktaba

On the site’s surfaces

Maktaba
Maktaba
MaktabaLight

Never

  • Recolour the icon, or set it on a light tile.
  • Stretch, rotate or mirror it. The arch is symmetric, and stays as drawn in Arabic.
  • Set the name in another face, or letter-space the Arabic.
  • Put the two names on one line without the rule between them.
Maktabaمكتبة

Maktaba keeps a household’s films and series on its own computer, and plays them on every screen at home, in Arabic and English. Free and open source, under the MIT licence.
